name: Aiea
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Aiea, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Aiea, Hawaii for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Aiea keeps Christmas with local parades, Santa visits and community events.
celebrates: Aiea's Christmas is anchored by Pearlridge Center, which runs the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Mauka Center Court from November 21, 2026, to January 10, 2027, and puts Santa in Santa's Holiday Workshop in Wai Makai Center Court. The Aiea Community Association holds its Christmas Parade and Family Fun Fair on Saturday, December 12, ending beside the Aiea Library at the Old Sugar Mill site. The library has a free Santa Claus Story Time on December 23. Train hours vary by week, and the train is closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.
lastyear: We did not find a 2025 recap on the host pages. The Aiea Community Association's parade page says the Christmas parade and Family Fun Fair have become an annual community event and that, in past years, the Hawaii Blood Bank accepted donations at the fair and Kaiser Permanente's mobile clinic offered flu shots. Groups can apply online to march, perform or run a booth.
facts: The Aiea Public Library stands on the site of the former Aiea Sugar Mill and opened on July 19, 2014. The $10.4 million building earned LEED Gold certification in August 2014. The Aiea Community Association, which runs the parade, is a 501(c)(3) organization. Pearlridge Center says it hosts more than 300 events a year and calls itself Aiea's premier shopping destination.
trains: Pearlridge Center in Aiea runs the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train in Mauka Center Court from November 21, 2026, to January 10, 2027, at $6 per child for children under 48 inches tall. A 10-ride booklet for $41 that includes a free Santa photo and free keiki rides on Friday, November 27, from 8 to 10 am. The Hawaiian Railway Society in Ewa Beach runs a Holiday Express Train Ride, a 90-minute nonstop evening ride decorated with hundreds of lights where riders can wear holiday pajamas, according to our museum page on the society.
train_links: Oahu's only operating historic railway, with a Holiday Express Train Ride on restored track.
traditions: A miniature train in Mauka Center Court for children under 48 inches tall.
Santa photos in Wai Makai Center Court through December 24.

kidfact: Aiea's library was built on the site of an old sugar mill.
faq: With the Pearlridge Express Holiday Train, Santa photos at Pearlridge Center, the Aiea Christmas Parade and Family Fun Fair and a library Santa story time.
When is the Aiea Christmas Parade in 2026?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, starting at 9 am at Pearlridge Elementary School.
How much is the Pearlridge holiday train?
$6 per child, or a 10-ride booklet for $41. Keiki ride free on November 27 from 8 to 10 am.
Where can kids meet Santa in Aiea?
At Santa's Holiday Workshop at Pearlridge Center through December 24, or at the library's story time on December 23.
Is there a free Christmas event in Aiea?
Yes, the parade and fair and the library's Santa Claus Story Time are free.

folded.why: No separate verified events. A Very Merry Fest at Pearlridge (Dec 5 and 6) is a vendor expo with no kids' activities printed, so it is held.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Aiea for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (Pearlridge Express Holiday Train Rides) through January 10 (the same train), with Photos with Santa at Pearlridge Center (through December 24), the Aiea Christmas Parade and Family Fun Fair (December 12) and Santa Claus Story Time (December 23) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
